articles.summary: On September 12, 2025, the EU Data Act became fully applicable across the EU. Over the past weeks, we’ve explored the regulation in detail: what it covers, what it means in practice, and how energy companies can go beyond compliance to create real value. Now we’ve brought those insights together into one comprehensive report: The EU Data Act: what it means for the energy industry.
articles.title: The EU Data Act: what it means for the energy industry
